A travelling family was attacked and their belongings were hidden by trolls and minotaurs in {wiki:Dusalk's Troll Clan Cave|Dusalk's troll clan cave}, east of the Dwarf Bridge. Go down into the cave, get past the minotaurs and open the quest boxes to recover a {item:Longsword}, a {item:Wedding Ring} and other objects.
A travelling family was attacked and their belongings were hidden by trolls and minotaurs.
Troll cave, east of the Dwarf Bridge
The {creature:Minotaur Mage} attacks with ranged magic: get close quickly or attack it first.

Go to the troll cave ({wiki:Dusalk's Troll Clan Cave|Kazordoon Troll Den}) **east** of the {wiki:Dwarf Bridge|Dwarf Bridge}, between Kazordoon and Venore. The Dwarf Bridge is northeast of Thais and northwest of Venore: go on foot from either of these cities, cross the bridge and head **east**. The entrance is a hole **hidden behind a tree**: open it with the {item:Shovel} and go down.
Inside the cave, go **south** and look for the stairs going down.
Map 1: path south to the stairs
There are {creature:Slime|Slimes} **north** of the cave entrance. They are in a sewer below, but someone may have pulled them up by rope to the main floor.
On the floor below, go **north**. The {creature:Minotaur Archer} and the {creature:Minotaur Mage} are in the room to the north, but they may have been lured elsewhere.
Map 2: path north to the big room
The quest crates are at the far **north** end of the big room. Open them to recover the family's belongings.

Go back the same way: return **south** to the stairs, go up and head **north** to the entrance hole, where you climb out with the {item:Rope}. Outside, cross the Dwarf Bridge to go back to Thais (southwest) or head southeast to Venore.
